tickerText: [TENNIS] Round-of-16 play begins Oct. 2 at the China Open and Japan Open after Alexander Zverev topped Cameron Norrie 7-6(1), 6-4 without injured No. 1 Jannik Sinner, Carlos Alcaraz advanced in Tokyo, and Kei Nishikori ended his career with a tearful 6-4, 6-4 loss to Frances Tiafoe • [SQUASH] Champion Fiberglass Swedish Open quarterfinals move to the GIH glass court in Stockholm on Oct. 2 with 16 of the world's top 20 chasing equal $109,000 purses ahead of weekend semifinals and Sunday finals • [BADMINTON] An Se-young's back-to-back Asian Games women's singles gold closed the Aichi-Nagoya tournament on Sept. 29 as Malaysia's juniors turn toward the BWF World Junior Championships team draw starting Oct. 7 in Cairo • [PICKLEBALL] Pro quarterfinals at the Rate Las Vegas Open hit Darling Tennis Center on Oct. 2 with Anna Leigh Waters two doubles titles from career No. 200 and $1.06M in payouts across the 1,000-point Open • [TABLE TENNIS] WTT China Smash qualifying rolls on at Beijing's Shougang Park through Oct. 3 before the Oct. 4 main draw, with Félix Lebrun the men's top seed as post-Asiad rests thin China's men's singles field

newsItems.title: Nishikori Bows Out In Tokyo
newsItems.excerpt: Kei Nishikori lost 6-4, 6-4 to Frances Tiafoe in his Japan Open farewell on Oct. 1, while Alexander Zverev beat Cameron Norrie 7-6(1), 6-4 at the Sinner-less China Open as both ATP 500 events reach the round of 16 on Oct. 2.

newsItems.title: Swedish Open Hits Glass QFs
newsItems.excerpt: Stockholm's Champion Fiberglass Swedish Open shifts to the GIH glass court for men's and women's quarterfinals on Oct. 2, with 16 of the world's top 20 in the field before semifinals Saturday and $109,000 titles Sunday.

newsItems.title: Vegas Open Reaches Quarterfinals
newsItems.excerpt: The Carvana PPA Tour's Rate Las Vegas Open moves to pro quarterfinals on Oct. 2 at Darling Tennis Center, with Anna Leigh Waters—skipping singles—two doubles wins from career title No. 200 on a $1.06M Open weekend.

newsItems.title: China Smash Field Takes Shape
newsItems.excerpt: Qualifying continues through Oct. 3 at the WTT China Smash in Beijing before the Oct. 4 main draw, with Félix Lebrun the men's top seed as Wang Chuqin and Lin Shidong sit out and Sun Yingsha and Wang Manyu lead a loaded women's field.
